repo-dialog-scope.title: Repo selection dialog: where it is used and what it contains
repo-dialog-scope.value: One shared `Repositories` dialog used by New Task and `CreateTaskFromIssueDialog` (the Git Integration issue modal). It offers multi-select of registered projects, an `Add folder…` native picker, a base-branch field per repo, and remove. The New Task panel shows a summary line (`3 repositories`) and a `Manage` button instead of per-repo rows; with exactly one repo, today's inline branch/base fields stay. The pipeline form needs no separate dialog because it is the same New Task form.

dedupe-no-cap.title: Dedupe and the no-cap rule
dedupe-no-cap.value: Dedupe selected projects by git root: two registered projects under one repo collapse to one worktree. No hard cap and no 400 for a large selection; show a non-blocking warning above 10 repositories (`this task will create 11 worktrees and may be slow`). Worktree creation and status polling run in bounded batches regardless of N.

prompt-block-format.title: Exact `Repositories:` block
prompt-block-format.value:
In the launch prompt only:

`Repositories:`
`- <name>: <absolute worktree path> (branch <branch>)`

One bullet per repo, no product name, no other prose. The aggregate commit/push prompt is the existing user-triggered template and names the repos itself, so it does not repeat this block.

existing-branch-multi.title: `existingBranch` with multiple repos
existing-branch-multi.value: `existingBranch` stays single-repo only. A multi-repo create that sends it is rejected 400 with a clear message; per-repo existing-branch selection is a separate future feature.

create-only-confirm.title: Confirm create-only drops the issue's 'or editing a card'
create-only-confirm.value: Confirm: the repo set is fixed at creation. Changing it means a new card. This narrows issue #291's 'creating or editing a card' to creation only.
